title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
福建鄉試錄序
聖天子御極之十有一年是爲丙
子天下復當賓興之期福建
藩司舉行如制巡按監察御
史胡文靜寔柄其事而臨焉
初藩司以禮聘考試官請則
既曰諾宜重幣以往繼又曰
===
閩大藩也場屋湫隘待士之
制未稱乃檄所司斥公帑之
餘新之凡一切條貫罔有不
悉心綜理者于時鎮守福建
太監崔安提督市舶太監尚
春皆雅重儒術恊規相成而
總理閩浙鹺政左副都御史
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 一
punctuated:
福建鄉試錄序

聖天子御極之十有一年，是爲丙子，天下復當賓興之期。福建藩司舉行如制，巡按監察御史胡文靜寔柄其事而臨焉。初，藩司以禮聘考試官，請，則既曰：「諾，宜重幣以往。」繼又曰：「閩大藩也，場屋湫隘，待士之制未稱。」乃檄所司，斥公帑之餘新之。凡一切條貫，罔有不悉心綜理者。于時，鎮守福建太監崔安、提督市舶太監尚春，皆雅重儒術，恊規相成，而總理閩浙鹺政左副都御史
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Fujian Provincial Examination

In the eleventh year of the sagely Son of Heaven’s reign, the bingzi year [1516], the time had again come throughout the realm to honor and recommend worthy men through the examinations. The Fujian Provincial Administration Commission conducted the examination according to the regulations. The Regional Inspector, Investigating Censor Hu Wenjing, held responsibility for the undertaking and supervised it. Initially, when the Commission sought approval to invite Examiners with due ceremony, he assented, saying: “Yes. Substantial gifts should accompany the invitation.” He subsequently added: “Fujian is a major province, but its examination compound is cramped and confined. Its arrangements for receiving the candidates do not befit its standing.” He therefore issued instructions to the responsible offices to allocate surplus public funds to renovate it. He gave thorough and painstaking attention to every regulation and arrangement.

At that time, Cui An, the Grand Eunuch stationed in Fujian, and Shang Chun, the Grand Eunuch supervising maritime trade, both held Confucian learning in high esteem. They coordinated their plans and assisted one another in bringing them to fruition. And the Left Vice Censor-in-Chief administering the salt affairs of Fujian and Zhejiang …

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
陳天祥巡撫汀漳諸郡右僉
都御史文森清戎監察御史
王應鵬南京督稅戶部員外郎
徐度各以事蒞閩惟是作興
士類為務士益爭自淬礪以
躍以奮既八月魯等亦應聘
而集御史文靜遂偕入場屋
===
以魯與訓導夏亨為考試官
學正陳仲珠胡希銓教諭吳
瑛閻志學吳鎧杜鸞沈磐訓
導徐衍為同考試官提調則
左布政使伍符右布政使姚
鏌監試則按察使王金僉事
胡鐸贊襄防範于外則左叅
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 二
punctuated: 陳天祥、巡撫汀漳諸郡右僉都御史文森、清戎監察御史王應鵬、南京督稅戶部員外郎徐度，各以事蒞閩，惟是作興士類為務。士益爭自淬礪，以躍以奮。既八月，魯等亦應聘而集，御史文靜遂偕入場屋，以魯與訓導夏亨為考試官，學正陳仲珠、胡希銓，教諭吳瑛、閻志學、吳鎧、杜鸞、沈磐，訓導徐衍為同考試官。提調則左布政使伍符、右布政使姚鏌；監試則按察使王金、僉事胡鐸；贊襄防範于外，則左叅
translation_en:
…Chen Tianxiang; Wen Sen, Right Assistant Censor-in-chief and Grand Coordinator of Tingzhou, Zhangzhou, and other prefectures; Wang Yingpeng, Investigating Censor charged with inspecting military affairs; and Xu Du, Vice Director in the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue charged with supervising taxation, each came to Fujian on official business. They made encouraging and fostering the scholars their principal concern. The scholars competed all the more earnestly to hone themselves, eager to rise and distinguish themselves.

In the eighth month, Lu and the others also assembled in response to their invitations. Censor Wen Jing then entered the examination compound together with them. Lu and Xia Heng, an Assistant Instructor, were appointed Examiners. Chen Zhongzhu and Hu Xiquan, Instructors; Wu Ying, Yan Zhixue, Wu Kai, Du Luan, and Shen Pan, Instructors; and Xu Yan, an Assistant Instructor, were appointed Associate Examiners. The Proctors were Wu Fu, Left Provincial Administration Commissioner, and Yao Mo, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner. Those supervising the examination were Wang Jin, Provincial Surveillance Commissioner, and Hu Duo, Assistant Surveillance Commissioner. Those assisting with precautions outside the compound included the Left…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
政陳策右參政艾洪左參議
彭夔右參議鄭毅副使陳懷
經唐澤僉事蔡天祐查約胡
璉趙官署都指揮僉事楊勳
李胤而下及內外百執事皆
選諸有司之良無濫預者如
期乃合提學副使劉玉所取
===
列郡士而三試之惟嚴惟慎
惟公且加詳焉遵
制額拔其尤者得九十人并擇
其文二十一篇為錄以
獻以傳魯當序諸首簡維閩有
塲屋舊矣初建於會城之南
旋病其陋巳再徙今復病其
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 三
punctuated:
政陳策、右參政艾洪、左參議彭夔、右參議鄭毅、副使陳懷經、唐澤、僉事蔡天祐、查約、胡璉、趙官、署都指揮僉事楊勳、李胤，而下及內外百執事，皆選諸有司之良，無濫預者。如期乃合提學副使劉玉所取列郡士，而三試之，惟嚴惟慎惟公，且加詳焉。遵制額，拔其尤者，得九十人，并擇其文二十一篇為錄，以獻以傳。魯當序諸首簡。
維閩有塲屋舊矣，初建於會城之南，旋病其陋，巳再徙，今復病其
translation_en:
…Chen Ce, Left Administration Vice Commissioner; Ai Hong, Right Administration Vice Commissioner; Peng Kui, Left Administration Assistant Commissioner; Zheng Yi, Right Administration Assistant Commissioner; Chen Huaijing and Tang Ze, Surveillance Vice Commissioners; Cai Tianyou, Zha Yue, Hu Lian, and Zhao Guan, Surveillance Assistant Commissioners; and Yang Xun and Li Yin, acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioners. From these officials down to all the functionaries serving inside and outside the examination compound, everyone was selected from the best personnel of the responsible offices; none was admitted indiscriminately. At the appointed time, the candidates from the various prefectures selected by Liu Yu, Surveillance Vice Commissioner for Education, were assembled and examined in three sessions. Strictness, care, and impartiality were observed throughout, with added attention to detail. In accordance with the quota prescribed by imperial decree, ninety outstanding candidates were selected. Twenty-one of their essays were also chosen for inclusion in a record, to be presented to the throne and circulated. It fell to me, Lu, to write the preface at the beginning of the volume.
Fujian has long had an examination compound. It was first built south of the provincial capital, but its inadequacy soon became a concern. It has already been relocated twice; now once again there is concern about its…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
未廣也乃加闢焉門庭宏邃
棟宇壯傑而丹臒炳炳交輝
新規既拓舊構復華觀者罔
不動容屬目以爲場屋之觀
其備於是乎然則天下之事
耻冗近而嚮高明厭卑小而
慕遠大蓋亦莫不有然者矣
即以閩士言之秦漢以來固
未齒於上國唐時歐陽詹以
文辭名林蘊以忠義著而閩
士寖以有聞然未徵於事功
而無考於道德亦猶夫故耳
未也歷唐至北宋有楊文公
之詞藻有曾公亮之簡靜有
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 四
punctuated:
未廣也，乃加闢焉。門庭宏邃，棟宇壯傑，而丹臒炳炳交輝。新規既拓，舊構復華，觀者罔不動容屬目，以爲場屋之觀，其備於是乎！然則天下之事，耻冗近而嚮高明，厭卑小而慕遠大，蓋亦莫不有然者矣。
即以閩士言之，秦漢以來，固未齒於上國。唐時歐陽詹以文辭名，林蘊以忠義著，而閩士寖以有聞。然未徵於事功，而無考於道德，亦猶夫故耳。未也，歷唐至北宋，有楊文公之詞藻，有曾公亮之簡靜，有
translation_en:
…it was not spacious enough, so it was further enlarged. Its gates and courtyards are grand and deep, its buildings imposing, and its painted decoration [?] gleams brilliantly, each part enhancing the others. With the new plan expanded and the old structures restored to splendor, everyone who sees it is moved and gazes intently, thinking: surely the examination compound has now attained its full magnificence! So too with affairs throughout the world: to feel ashamed of the commonplace and short-sighted and aspire to the lofty and enlightened, to tire of the lowly and small and yearn for the far-reaching and great—surely this inclination is universal.
Take the scholars of Fujian, for example. Since the Qin and Han dynasties, they had not been ranked alongside those of the central regions. During the Tang, Ouyang Zhan became renowned for his literary compositions, and Lin Yun distinguished himself through loyalty and righteousness; thus Fujian’s scholars gradually became known. Yet their practical achievements had not been demonstrated, nor was there evidence of their attainment in the Way and virtue, so things remained much as before. This was not yet enough. From the Tang down to the Northern Song, there were the literary brilliance of Yang Wengong, the simplicity and calm of Zeng Gongliang, and…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
蔡君謨之惠政有陳述古諸
先生之講授而閩之人物所
謂文學也事功道德也皆彬
彬日趨於美矣而猶未也厥
後李忠定者起遂以相業偉
一世巍然負古大臣之望龜
山身游程門載道而南一時
===
唱和率稱大儒沿至考亭朱
子遂集羣儒之大成用其功
與夫子並居名闕里俗號鄒
魯而武夷雲谷諸峯攢翠聳
碧峩峩然與龜蒙鳧繹相高
游覽於建溪清源之勝者亦
真若浴沂水而挹春風也事
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 五
punctuated: 蔡君謨之惠政，有陳述古諸先生之講授，而閩之人物，所謂文學也、事功道德也，皆彬彬日趨於美矣。而猶未也。厥後李忠定者起，遂以相業偉一世，巍然負古大臣之望。龜山身游程門，載道而南，一時唱和，率稱大儒。沿至考亭朱子，遂集羣儒之大成，用其功與夫子並，居名闕里，俗號鄒魯。而武夷、雲谷諸峯，攢翠聳碧，峩峩然與龜、蒙、鳧、繹相高。游覽於建溪、清源之勝者，亦真若浴沂水而挹春風也。事
translation_en: …the benevolent administration of Cai Junmo, and the teaching of masters such as Chen Shugu. Thus, among the notable men of Fujian, literary learning, practical achievements, and moral cultivation all flourished, advancing daily toward excellence. Yet this was still not the culmination. Thereafter Li Zhongding arose, becoming an outstanding figure of his age through his achievements as chief councilor and bearing, in his eminence, the prestige of the great ministers of antiquity. Guishan personally studied in the Cheng school and carried the Way southward. Those who joined in its advocacy at the time were generally acclaimed as great Confucian scholars. This tradition continued down to Master Zhu of Kaoting, who brought together and perfected the learning of the assembled scholars. Through his achievements he ranked alongside the Master, Confucius; his dwelling was called Queli, and the region was styled Zou and Lu. The peaks of Wuyi and Yungu, clustered in verdure and soaring in emerald hues, stood loftily, rivaling Mounts Gui, Meng, Fu, and Yi in height. Those who visited the scenic wonders of Jianxi and Qingyuan truly felt as though they were bathing in the Yi River and taking in the spring breeze. Practical achievements…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
功德學之盛皆所謂宏以邃
傑以壯者而雄跨百代矣世
寧有不瞻而仰之者哉閩人
之觀不至是始備哉入我
國朝如張翠屏楊文敏林莊敏
彭惠安諸名公相繼而起是
則所謂華舊構者也流聲實
===
於天下者也其於閩不重有
光哉諸士子登名斯錄皆閩
之俊而亦
國家所養育以待用者其將何
以爲謀哉夫自吾之筮仕而
至於爲大夫爲卿佐爲宰輔
位之不同而皆有事業之期
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 六
punctuated:
功德學之盛，皆所謂宏以邃、傑以壯者，而雄跨百代矣。世寧有不瞻而仰之者哉？閩人之觀，不至是始備哉？入我國朝，如張翠屏、楊文敏、林莊敏、彭惠安諸名公，相繼而起，是則所謂華舊構者也，流聲實於天下者也。其於閩，不重有光哉？
諸士子登名斯錄，皆閩之俊，而亦國家所養育以待用者，其將何以爲謀哉？夫自吾之筮仕，而至於爲大夫、爲卿佐、爲宰輔，位之不同，而皆有事業之期
translation_en:
…the flourishing of achievements, virtue, and learning—all exemplify what is called breadth with depth, distinction with grandeur, towering over a hundred generations. Could anyone in the world fail to look upon them with admiration? Is it not only with these that a view of Fujian becomes complete? Under our present dynasty, such eminent gentlemen as Zhang Cuiping, Yang Wenmin, Lin Zhuangmin, and Peng Hui’an arose in succession. These were men who, as the saying goes, embellished the inherited edifice, spreading both their reputation and their substantive achievements throughout the realm. Did they not bring renewed glory to Fujian?
The scholars whose names appear in this record are all outstanding men of Fujian, nurtured by the state in readiness for service. What plans will they now make? From our first entry into official service to becoming grand masters, ministers and their assistants, or chief ministers, our ranks differ, yet at every level there is the expectation of accomplishment in public service…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
焉必求以日新難也自吾之
家之一鄉以至於一國天下
與後世地之不同而皆有名
稱之繫焉必求以自立又難
也諸士子其得不益慎於所
習益勤於所事以為邦邑重
且以副主司望哉昔孔融論
===
東南之美謂會稽竹箭不足
以當之而歸諸季札虞翻二
子融言人材為山川應可也
謂其盡於二子非矣然則八
閩之靈之秀諸士子固當有
繼起而乘之者豈先正之所
能專哉蘇潁濱上韓太尉書
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 七
punctuated: 焉，必求以日新，難也。自吾之家之一鄉，以至於一國、天下與後世，地之不同，而皆有名稱之繫焉，必求以自立，又難也。諸士子其得不益慎於所習，益勤於所事，以為邦邑重，且以副主司望哉？昔孔融論東南之美，謂會稽竹箭不足以當之，而歸諸季札、虞翻二子。融言人材為山川應，可也；謂其盡於二子，非矣。然則八閩之靈之秀，諸士子固當有繼起而乘之者，豈先正之所能專哉？蘇潁濱《上韓太尉書》
translation_en: …in each position. To strive continually to renew oneself each day is difficult. From one’s own household to a village, and thence to a state, all under Heaven, and later generations, the spheres differ, yet in each one’s reputation is at stake. To strive to establish oneself is difficult too. Can you scholars, then, fail to be still more careful in what you study and still more diligent in what you undertake, so as to bring distinction to your localities and fulfill the expectations of the examiners? In discussing the finest things of the southeast, Kong Rong once said that the bamboo arrow shafts of Kuaiji were insufficient to merit that designation, and instead assigned it to the two men Ji Zha and Yu Fan. Rong was right to say that human talent arises in response to the mountains and rivers; he was wrong to say that it was exhausted in these two men. Thus, among you scholars there surely must be those who will rise in succession to inherit the spiritual vitality and excellence of the Eight Min regions of Fujian. How could these belong exclusively to the worthies of earlier times? In Su Yingbin’s Letter Submitted to Grand Commandant Han…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
謂見歐陽子固已為愜猶以
未見太尉為恨此潁濱之善
於求天下之大觀也諸士子
疇昔所慕必嘗動高山之仰
毋亦有舍歐陽而慕稚圭者
乎魯於諸士子既以文字相
知矣然欲進諸士子於道誠
===
不能貢諛言為悅也故特用
其所以忠告者而諄諄焉
浙江寧波府慈谿縣儒學訓
導閔魯謹序
banxin: 福建鄉試錄前序 八
punctuated:
謂見歐陽子固已為愜，猶以未見太尉為恨，此潁濱之善於求天下之大觀也。諸士子疇昔所慕，必嘗動高山之仰，毋亦有舍歐陽而慕稚圭者乎？魯於諸士子既以文字相知矣，然欲進諸士子於道，誠不能貢諛言為悅也，故特用其所以忠告者而諄諄焉。
浙江寧波府慈谿縣儒學訓導閔魯謹序。
translation_en:
…says that although meeting Master Ouyang had already brought him satisfaction, he still regretted not having met the Grand Commandant. This shows Yingbin’s skill in seeking out the grandest sights in the world. The men whom you candidates have long admired must surely have inspired in you the reverence felt when gazing up at a lofty mountain. Might there also be some among you who turn from Ouyang to admire Zhigui? I, Lu, have already come to know you candidates through your writing. Yet, wishing to advance you in the Way, I truly cannot offer flattering words merely to please you. Thus I speak earnestly and at length, offering you my sincere counsel.
Respectfully prefaced by Min Lu, Assistant Instructor in the Confucian School of Cixi County, Ningbo Prefecture, Zhejiang.

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
正德十一年福建鄉試
監臨官
巡按福建監察御史胡文靜〔士寧浙江山陰縣人戊辰進士〕
提調官
福建等處承宣布政使司左布政使伍符〔朝信江西安福縣人丁未進士〕
福建等處承宣布政使司右布政使姚鏌〔英之浙江慈谿縣人癸丑進士〕
監試官
福建等處提刑按察司按察使王金〔曰良河南臨潁縣人壬戌進士〕
福建等處提刑按察司僉事胡鐸〔時振浙江餘姚縣人乙丑進士〕
===
考試官
浙江寧波府慈谿縣儒學訓導閔魯〔宗道江西南昌縣人庚午貢士〕
河南河南府洛陽縣儒學訓導夏亨〔本元陝西咸寧縣人癸酉貢士〕
同考試官
河南開封府睢州儒學學正陳仲珠〔永輝浙江諸暨縣人庚午貢士〕
河南汝州儒學學正胡希銓〔克脩江西弋陽縣人庚午貢士〕
浙江紹興府餘姚縣儒學教諭吳瑛〔廷潔南京錦衣衛人甲子貢士〕
直隸鎮江府丹陽縣儒學教諭閻志學〔汝遜直隸淶水縣人丁卯貢士〕
江西饒州府餘干縣儒學教諭吳鎧〔廷儀湖廣武陵縣人丙午貢士〕
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 一
punctuated:
正德十一年福建鄉試。

監臨官：
巡按福建監察御史胡文靜〔士寧，浙江山陰縣人，戊辰進士〕。

提調官：
福建等處承宣布政使司左布政使伍符〔朝信，江西安福縣人，丁未進士〕。
福建等處承宣布政使司右布政使姚鏌〔英之，浙江慈谿縣人，癸丑進士〕。

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
瞻之在前忽焉在後
夫微之顯誠之不可揜如此夫
日月有明容光必照焉
易
剛自外來而為主於內
健而說决而和
故神无方而易无體
===
是故變化云為吉事有祥象事知器占事
知來天地設位聖人成能人謀鬼謀百
姓與能
書
一日二日萬幾
監于先王成憲其永無愆惟說式克欽承
旁招俊乂列于庶位王曰嗚呼說四海
之內咸仰朕德時乃風股肱惟人良臣
惟聖昔先正保衡作我先王乃曰予弗
banxin: 福建鄉試錄五
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

瞻之在前，忽焉在後。

夫微之顯，誠之不可揜，如此夫！

日月有明，容光必照焉。

易

剛自外來而為主於內。

健而說，决而和。

故神无方，而易无體。

是故變化云為，吉事有祥；象事知器，占事知來。天地設位，聖人成能；人謀鬼謀，百姓與能。

書

一日二日萬幾。

監于先王成憲，其永無愆。惟說式克欽承。

旁招俊乂，列于庶位。王曰：「嗚呼！說，四海之內咸仰朕德，時乃風。股肱惟人，良臣惟聖。昔先正保衡作我先王，乃曰：『予弗
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

“I look for it ahead; suddenly it is behind.”

“Such is the manifestation of the subtle, and the impossibility of concealing sincerity!”

“The sun and moon possess brightness; wherever light can enter, they unfailingly illuminate.”

Book of Changes

“The firm comes from outside and becomes the master within.”

“Strong yet joyous; resolute yet harmonious.”

“Thus the numinous has no fixed location, and change has no fixed form.”

“Thus, in transformations, speech, and action, auspicious undertakings have favorable signs. By taking affairs as images, one understands implements; by divining about affairs, one knows what is to come. Heaven and Earth establish their positions, and the sage brings their capacities to fulfillment. Humans deliberate and spirits deliberate, and the common people share in their efficacy.”

Book of Documents

“In one day, in two days, there are ten thousand incipient affairs to attend to.”

“Look to the established statutes of the former kings, and you will forever be without error.” “I, Yue, shall indeed reverently receive and uphold this instruction.”

“He sought worthy and capable men far and wide and arrayed them in the various offices. The king said: ‘Ah, Yue! All within the Four Seas look up to my virtue: this is the effect of your influence. As arms and legs are to a person, so are good ministers to a sage ruler. Formerly, the chief minister Baoheng assisted our former king and said: “I do not …

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
克俾厥后惟堯舜其心愧耻若撻于市
一夫不獲則曰時予之辜佑我烈祖格
于皇天爾尚明保予罔俾阿衡專美有
商惟后非賢不乂惟賢非后不食其爾
克紹乃辟于先王永綏民說拜稽首曰
敢對揚天子之休命
視曰明聽曰聰
惟齊非齊有倫有要
詩
===
我送舅氏曰至渭陽何以贈之路車乘黄
我送舅氏悠悠我思何以贈之瓊瑰玉
佩
衆維魚矣旐維旟矣
作之屏之其菑其翳脩之平之其灌其栵
啓之辟之其檉其椐攘之剔之其檿其
柘
受小國是達受大國是達
春秋
banxin: 福建鄉試録 六
punctuated:
克俾厥后惟堯舜」，其心愧耻若撻于市。一夫不獲，則曰：「時予之辜。」佑我烈祖，格于皇天。爾尚明保予，罔俾阿衡專美有商。惟后非賢不乂，惟賢非后不食。其爾克紹乃辟于先王，永綏民。說拜稽首，曰：「敢對揚天子之休命。」

視曰明，聽曰聰。

惟齊非齊，有倫有要。

詩

我送舅氏，曰至渭陽。何以贈之？路車乘黄。我送舅氏，悠悠我思。何以贈之？瓊瑰玉佩。

衆維魚矣，旐維旟矣。

作之屏之，其菑其翳。脩之平之，其灌其栵。啓之辟之，其檉其椐。攘之剔之，其檿其柘。

受小國是達，受大國是達。

春秋
translation_en:
…able to make his ruler a Yao or a Shun,” he felt as ashamed at heart as though he had been flogged in the marketplace. If even one man failed to find his proper place, he would say, “This is my fault.” He aided my illustrious ancestor, whose virtue reached August Heaven. May you wisely protect me, and not allow Aheng [Yi Yin] alone to enjoy the glory of serving Shang. Without worthy men, a ruler cannot govern; without a ruler, worthy men cannot be sustained. May you enable your sovereign to carry on the work of the former kings and bring lasting peace to the people. Yue bowed and knocked his head to the ground, saying, “I venture to acknowledge and extol the Son of Heaven’s gracious command.”

In seeing, the requisite quality is clarity; in hearing, it is acuity.

To bring order to what is unequal, there are proper gradations and essential principles.

Book of Odes

I escorted my maternal uncle as far as the northern bank of the Wei River. What did I give him? A grand carriage and four yellow horses. I escorted my maternal uncle; long and lingering were my thoughts. What did I give him? Precious jade and jade pendants.

The multitude is like a shoal of fish; the tortoise-and-serpent banners and the falcon banners fly.

They cut them down and cleared them away—the dead standing trees and the tangled growth. They trimmed them and levelled them—the shrubs and the shoots. They opened up and cleared the ground—the tamarisks and the ju trees. They uprooted them and stripped them away—the mountain mulberries and the silkworm thorns.

Entrusted with a small state, he succeeded; entrusted with a large state, he succeeded.

Spring and Autumn Annals

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
公會齊人宋人救鄭莊公二十八年
虞師晉師滅下陽僖公二年晉人執虞公
僖公五年楚師滅陳昭公八年楚師滅
蔡昭公十一年晉伐鮮虞昭公十二年
晉侯齊師宋師秦師及楚人戰于城濮楚
師敗績僖公二十八年會于蕭魚襄公
十一年
楚子滅胡以胡子豹歸定公十五年
禮記
===
君車將駕則僕執策立於馬前已駕僕展
軨效駕奮衣由右上取貳綏跪乘執策
分轡驅之五步而立君出就車則僕并
轡授綏左右攘辟車驅而騶至于大門
君撫僕之手而顧命車右就車門閭溝
渠必步
大樂必易大禮必簡
君子也者人之成名也
廉而不劌義也
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 七
punctuated:
公會齊人、宋人救鄭，莊公二十八年。
虞師、晉師滅下陽，僖公二年；晉人執虞公，僖公五年；楚師滅陳，昭公八年；楚師滅蔡，昭公十一年；晉伐鮮虞，昭公十二年。
晉侯、齊師、宋師、秦師及楚人戰于城濮，楚師敗績，僖公二十八年；會于蕭魚，襄公十一年。
楚子滅胡，以胡子豹歸，定公十五年。
禮記
君車將駕，則僕執策立於馬前。已駕，僕展軨，效駕，奮衣，由右上，取貳綏，跪乘，執策，分轡，驅之五步而立。君出就車，則僕并轡授綏，左右攘辟。車驅而騶，至于大門，君撫僕之手而顧，命車右就車。門閭溝渠必步。
大樂必易，大禮必簡。
君子也者，人之成名也。
廉而不劌，義也。
translation_en:
The duke joined men of Qi and Song in relieving Zheng. Twenty-eighth year of Duke Zhuang.

The armies of Yu and Jin destroyed Xiayang. Second year of Duke Xi. Men of Jin seized the Duke of Yu. Fifth year of Duke Xi. The army of Chu destroyed Chen. Eighth year of Duke Zhao. The army of Chu destroyed Cai. Eleventh year of Duke Zhao. Jin attacked Xianyu. Twelfth year of Duke Zhao.

The Marquis of Jin and the armies of Qi, Song, and Qin fought against the men of Chu at Chengpu; the army of Chu suffered a crushing defeat. Twenty-eighth year of Duke Xi. They met at Xiaoyu. Eleventh year of Duke Xiang.

The Viscount of Chu destroyed Hu and returned with Bao, Viscount of Hu. Fifteenth year of Duke Ding.

Book of Rites

When the horses are about to be harnessed to the ruler’s carriage, the driver stands before them holding his whip. Once they are harnessed, the driver examines the carriage rails and tests the harnessing. He shakes out his robe, mounts from the right, takes the secondary mounting cord, kneels in the carriage, grasps his whip, separates the reins, and drives forward five paces before stopping. When the ruler comes out to approach the carriage, the driver gathers the reins and offers him the mounting cord, while the attendants on either side clear the way. The carriage moves forward, and the horses break into a trot. On reaching the main gate, the ruler lays his hand on the driver’s hand, looks back, and orders the attendant who rides on the right to board the carriage. At gates, village entrances, ditches, and channels, the horses must proceed at a walk.

Great music must be easy; great ritual must be simple.

“Gentleman” is the designation of a person who has attained full moral development.

To have an edge without cutting others is righteousness.

translation_en:
Second Session

Discourse: Yao and Shun united all under Heaven as a single body.

One topic from among edicts, proclamations, and memorials [科 doubtful]:
Compose an edict in the voice of the Han emperor admonishing officials of the two-thousand-shi rank to attend to their official duties. Second year of Emperor Jing’s Later Era.
Compose a Tang proclamation appointing Chu Suiliang Vice Director of the Chancellery and a participant in deliberations on court government. Eighteenth year of Zhenguan.
Compose a memorial of thanks by Lü Gongzhu and Sima Guang for the Song emperor’s edict ordering daily Classics Colloquia. First year of Zhiping.

Five legal judgments:
A colleague rendering a judgment and signing case documents on another’s behalf.
Marriage among Mongols and Semu people.
An incumbent official erecting a stele for himself without authorization.
Desertion by officers and soldiers serving on campaigns or in garrison defense.
Setting a fire deliberately to burn another person’s house.

Third Session

Five policy questions

Question: Since antiquity, whenever emperors and kings founded a dynasty, they invariably established institutions and regulations to bequeath to their sons…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
孫唐虞三代典則具存有足徵者自是
而降惟漢之高祖肇造漢家四百年之
鴻業號爲最盛而史臣之贊但云規模
宏遠而不及其詳何也洪惟我
太祖高皇帝以神聖之資際貞元之會不階尺
土奮起淮甸掃除雄奸曾未數載而履
帝位雖當干戈倥偬之餘而常留意於制作宏
綱旣舉萬目又張凡前王之所未行與
行之而未盡者皆燦然有條而可以爲
===
後世法誠所謂度越千古者矣當時儒
臣宋濂之序
聖政記乃特借漢以爲喻始言與高祖同繼言
非高祖之所能及旣而又言比隆於唐
虞三代不知所同者何事所不能及者
何功而所可比隆乎前聖者又何道歟
今觀七類之中固皆有關於政要然天
地之化工誠非摹寫者所能盡然亦有
可類舉者歟諸士子躬逢其盛涵育
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 九
punctuated: 孫。唐虞三代典則具存，有足徵者。自是而降，惟漢之高祖肇造漢家四百年之鴻業，號爲最盛，而史臣之贊但云規模宏遠，而不及其詳，何也？洪惟我太祖高皇帝，以神聖之資，際貞元之會，不階尺土，奮起淮甸，掃除雄奸，曾未數載而履帝位。雖當干戈倥偬之餘，而常留意於制作。宏綱旣舉，萬目又張，凡前王之所未行與行之而未盡者，皆燦然有條，而可以爲後世法，誠所謂度越千古者矣。當時儒臣宋濂之序《聖政記》，乃特借漢以爲喻：始言與高祖同，繼言非高祖之所能及，旣而又言比隆於唐虞三代。不知所同者何事，所不能及者何功，而所可比隆乎前聖者又何道歟？今觀七類之中，固皆有關於政要，然天地之化工，誠非摹寫者所能盡，然亦有可類舉者歟？諸士子躬逢其盛，涵育
translation_en:
…descendants. The canonical institutions of Tang and Yu and the Three Dynasties survive in full and provide evidence for examination. Thereafter, Gaozu of the Han alone laid the foundations of the Han dynasty’s great enterprise of four hundred years, acclaimed as supremely flourishing. Yet the historian’s appraisal says only that his planning was grand and far-reaching, without supplying its particulars. Why is this?

We reverently reflect that our Emperor Taizu Gao, endowed with divine sagacity, encountered the juncture when an old order gave way to a new. Without so much as a foot of territory on which to build, he rose in the Huai region, swept away powerful evildoers, and, within a few short years, ascended the imperial throne. Even amid the aftermath of the tumult of warfare, he constantly attended to the establishment of institutions. Once the great guiding principles had been set forth, their myriad particulars were also put in place. Everything that former kings had left undone, or had undertaken without bringing to completion, was clearly and systematically ordered, to serve as a model for later ages. Truly, this was what is meant by surpassing all antiquity.

In his preface to the Record of Sagely Government (Shengzheng ji), the Confucian courtier Song Lian of that time specifically drew upon the Han as a comparison. First he said that our emperor was the same as Gaozu; next, that Gaozu could not match him; and then, that his greatness equaled that of Tang and Yu and the Three Dynasties. In what deeds were they alike? In what achievements could Gaozu not match him? And by what principles could he equal the greatness of the former sages?

Looking now at the seven categories, all certainly concern the essentials of government. Yet the transformative workings of Heaven and Earth cannot truly be exhausted by those who describe them. Even so, might examples be adduced by category? You examination candidates have yourselves had the good fortune to live amid this flourishing age, nurtured…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
聖政之餘澤蓋有年矣是必有習聞而與知者
其敬敷揚之毋畧
問通天下之故而達四方之志非史莫考
也蓋歷代相因之文備得失而垂鑒戒
故讀史者必師其迹若際其時面其人
而與之共事焉則庶乎其能擇矣然而
獨思則滯而不通獨為則困而不就姑
舉當時之施行與夫先儒之辯論者數
事與諸士商之考室宣王所以中興大
===
營宮室者或指其計在定都何有於不
知所務制作周公所以盛治請興禮樂
者或稱其身任天下何有於專事紛更
考道藝而興賢能取士之制古矣為吏
部而論罷科舉何惜其志不及施内經
國而外籌邊納榷之源遠矣為户部而
奏變鹽法何駁其議無可用明君以務
學為急四學竝立胡為而二道養民以
愛力為本三長定户奚為其不可宰相
banxin: 福建鄉試錄十
punctuated:
聖政之餘澤，蓋有年矣，是必有習聞而與知者，其敬敷揚之，毋畧。

問：通天下之故，而達四方之志，非史莫考也。蓋歷代相因之文，備得失而垂鑒戒，故讀史者必師其迹，若際其時、面其人，而與之共事焉，則庶乎其能擇矣。然而獨思則滯而不通，獨為則困而不就。姑舉當時之施行，與夫先儒之辯論者數事，與諸士商之。考室，宣王所以中興；大營宮室者，或指其計在定都，何有於不知所務？制作，周公所以盛治；請興禮樂者，或稱其身任天下，何有於專事紛更？考道藝而興賢能，取士之制古矣；為吏部而論罷科舉，何惜其志不及施？内經國而外籌邊，納榷之源遠矣；為户部而奏變鹽法，何駁其議無可用？明君以務學為急，四學竝立，胡為而二道？養民以愛力為本，三長定户，奚為其不可？宰相
translation_en:
…the beneficent legacy of sagely government has nurtured you for many years. Surely there are matters you have often heard about and come to understand. Respectfully expound them at length, omitting nothing.

Question: To comprehend the affairs of all under Heaven and understand the aspirations of the four quarters, there is nothing to consult but history. The writings transmitted through successive dynasties fully record successes and failures, leaving mirrors and warnings for posterity. Those who read history must therefore learn from its precedents, as though they lived in those times, met those people face to face, and worked alongside them. Only then may they come close to making sound choices. Yet thinking alone leads to stagnation without understanding, and acting alone leads to difficulty without accomplishment. Let us therefore take several instances of measures implemented in their day and arguments advanced by earlier Confucian scholars, and discuss them with you candidates.

Building palaces was a means by which King Xuan brought about a restoration. Of one who undertook extensive palace construction, some have said that his purpose was to establish the capital. How, then, could he be charged with failing to understand his proper priorities? Establishing institutions was a means by which the Duke of Zhou achieved flourishing government. Of one who requested the revival of rites and music, some have said that he personally took responsibility for all under Heaven. How, then, could he be charged with devoting himself solely to disruptive changes?

Examining moral cultivation and accomplishments and advancing the worthy and capable: the system for selecting officials is ancient. Why, then, is it considered regrettable that the intentions of one who served in the Ministry of Personnel and argued for abolishing the civil-service examinations were never implemented? Managing the state internally and planning frontier defense externally: the practice of accepting deliveries under the monopoly system [?] has a long history. Why, then, was the proposal of one who served in the Ministry of Revenue and memorialized to change the salt regulations rejected as wholly unusable?

An enlightened ruler regards the promotion of learning as urgent. When the four schools were established side by side, why were there two ways [?]? Nurturing the people rests on conserving their labor. Why was determining household registration through the Three Chiefs system deemed unacceptable? The chief councilor…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
百官之表智慮過人者何忽經濟之儒
諫議傲君之闕才稱傑出者何舎剛正
之士棄涼州倂力而守邊郡補衣之喻
似矣疽食何以見憂出駱谷乗虛而向
秦川善攻之計得矣仇國何為有諷更
化則善治也或每陳利害而一切報罷
或因求改制而勸行清淨厥義何居故
事可覆撿也或擇用衙官而斥去例簿
或始視銓事而命具科條所見孰得蓋
===
泥細故者必畧大猷要近效者必忘遠
利況夫形迹相持公私相撓事變之來
豈必盡強人意哉諸士子皆明當世之
務習先聖之術其有見乎此也審矣然
事貴有驗而言棄無徴盍為我悉心焉
問樂之難知也久矣考之樂記有知聲知
音知樂之等而釋之者謂孔子在齊之
所聞季札聘魯之所觀乃君子之知樂
者夫聞韶之㫖固不可得而考矣而札
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十一
punctuated:
百官之表，智慮過人者，何忽經濟之儒？諫議傲君之闕，才稱傑出者，何舎剛正之士？棄涼州，倂力而守邊郡，補衣之喻似矣，疽食何以見憂？出駱谷，乗虛而向秦川，善攻之計得矣，仇國何為有諷？更化則善治也，或每陳利害而一切報罷，或因求改制而勸行清淨，厥義何居？故事可覆撿也，或擇用衙官而斥去例簿，或始視銓事而命具科條，所見孰得？蓋泥細故者必畧大猷，要近效者必忘遠利。況夫形迹相持，公私相撓，事變之來，豈必盡強人意哉？諸士子皆明當世之務，習先聖之術，其有見乎此也審矣。然事貴有驗，而言棄無徴，盍為我悉心焉？

問：樂之難知也久矣。考之《樂記》，有知聲、知音、知樂之等，而釋之者謂孔子在齊之所聞、季札聘魯之所觀，乃君子之知樂者。夫聞韶之㫖，固不可得而考矣，而札
translation_en:
…the model for all officials: why did one whose wisdom and judgment surpassed others disregard scholars versed in statecraft? Remonstrance addresses the ruler’s shortcomings [?]: why did one acclaimed for outstanding ability pass over men of integrity and uprightness? Abandoning Liangzhou and concentrating forces to defend the frontier commanderies seemed aptly illustrated by the analogy of patching a garment; why, then, was concern expressed about an ulcer eating away at the body? Emerging through Luogu and exploiting an undefended opening to advance toward Qinchuan was a sound plan of attack; why, then, was there an admonition concerning an enemy state? Reform should bring good government. Yet in one case, proposals setting out advantages and disadvantages were repeatedly rejected in their entirety; in another, a request to change institutions elicited advice to govern through tranquility and noninterference. What principles underlay these responses? Precedents can be consulted and examined. Yet one man, when selecting subordinate officials, discarded the register of precedents, while another, upon first taking charge of personnel selection, ordered the relevant regulations to be assembled. Whose judgment was sound? Those who cling to minor details will surely neglect grand designs; those who demand immediate results will surely forget long-term benefits. Moreover, when outward conduct gives rise to mutual opposition and public and private interests interfere with one another, how can unfolding events invariably be forced to accord with one’s wishes? You candidates all understand the affairs of the present age and have studied the methods of the ancient sages; surely you have considered these matters carefully. Yet undertakings are valued for demonstrable results, and statements lacking evidence are rejected. Will you not devote your fullest attention to this for me?

Question: Music has long been difficult to understand. Examining the Record of Music, we find distinct levels of knowing sounds, knowing musical tones, and knowing music. Its interpreters say that what Confucius heard in Qi and what Ji Zha witnessed when visiting Lu as an envoy exemplify the gentleman’s understanding of music. The purport of hearing the Shao music can indeed no longer be ascertained through investigation; but Ji Zha…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
之所觀諸樂皆能知其德而通其政而
或者又議其論小雅豳風之失是果然
歟自是以降知樂者益鮮然亦有得趙
之牛鐸與周之玉尺者皆擅暗解神解
之名有依準以調八音與扣器以成宮
商者皆得心達心領之妙或得潤州之
玉磬而知失黃鍾之缺或見岑陽之古
鍾而識為姑洗之角或仰觀雲物而知
律管之飛灰或俯按樂圖而辨霓裳之
===
三疊之數子者其於季札果若是其班
歟夫審聲知音固幾於樂矣他如司馬
遷之律書不言律而言兵不言兵之用
而言兵之偃何以謂其知制律之意諸
葛亮之治蜀干戈方動于一隅而設施
未及於天下何以謂其禮樂之可興果
亦有其說歟近世以來又有朱蔡二先
正者出慨然以斯道自任乃獨究心於
殘篇斷簡之中而集為通解鐘律與律
banxin: 福建鄉試錄十二
punctuated: 之所觀諸樂，皆能知其德而通其政，而或者又議其論《小雅》《豳風》之失，是果然歟？自是以降，知樂者益鮮。然亦有得趙之牛鐸與周之玉尺者，皆擅暗解、神解之名；有依準以調八音與扣器以成宮商者，皆得心達、心領之妙；或得潤州之玉磬而知失黃鍾之缺，或見岑陽之古鍾而識為姑洗之角，或仰觀雲物而知律管之飛灰，或俯按樂圖而辨《霓裳》之三疊。之數子者，其於季札，果若是其班歟？夫審聲知音，固幾於樂矣。他如司馬遷之《律書》，不言律而言兵，不言兵之用而言兵之偃，何以謂其知制律之意？諸葛亮之治蜀，干戈方動于一隅，而設施未及於天下，何以謂其禮樂之可興？果亦有其說歟？近世以來，又有朱、蔡二先正者出，慨然以斯道自任，乃獨究心於殘篇斷簡之中，而集為《通解鐘律》與律
translation_en:
…Of all the music Ji Zha observed, he could discern the virtue it embodied and understand the government it reflected. Yet some have criticized errors in his judgments on the Lesser Odes and the Airs of Bin. Is this criticism indeed justified? Since his time, those who understand music have become increasingly rare. Nevertheless, there have been men who obtained an ox bell from Zhao or a jade measuring rule from Zhou, winning renown for intuitive or inspired understanding; others used a pitch-measuring instrument to tune the eight classes of musical instruments, or struck vessels to produce the gong and shang notes, attaining the subtle mastery of inward comprehension and intuitive apprehension. Some obtained a jade musical stone from Runzhou and recognized a deficiency in its Huangzhong pitch; some saw an ancient bell from Cenyang and identified its note as the jue of Guxian. Some looked upward at clouds and other atmospheric phenomena and understood the flight of ashes from pitch pipes; others bent over musical diagrams and distinguished the three repetitions in the Rainbow Skirt melody. Were these several men [?] truly peers of Ji Zha in this respect?

Discriminating sounds and understanding tones certainly brings one close to understanding music. But consider other cases. Sima Qian’s Treatise on the Pitch Standards discusses warfare rather than pitch standards, and the cessation of warfare rather than its employment. Why is he said to have understood the intention behind establishing pitch standards? When Zhuge Liang governed Shu, warfare was underway in one corner of the realm, and his institutions had not extended throughout the empire. Why is it said that rites and music could have flourished under him? Is there indeed an explanation for these claims?

In more recent times, the two former worthies Zhu and Cai emerged. Resolutely taking responsibility for this Way, they devoted their attention exclusively to fragmentary chapters and broken textual remnants, compiling them into the Comprehensive Explanation of Bells and Pitch Standards [?] and the Pitch…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
吕新書以傳於世庶幾古人之成法有
可考者使其見用於時不知果足以成
中和之治否歟我
國家
列聖有作累葉重光正積德久而禮樂可興之
時也諸士子生際其盛行當有爲
明天子獻者其將何所挾而往乎
問自古任天下之大事必有老成才識者
以當之而後計可决功可成變可濟也
===
故易稱丈人書美黃髮其訓有不可易
者考之於古隱居磻溪者成肆伐之功
弼亮四世者受保釐之寄周人家法具
見於是矣其後有監于夷門趙賴以存
少不如人鄭仰其救請用兵六十萬而
竟滅乎荆楚陳留屯十二事而坐困乎
先零薦以竒才者收唐室匡復之功呼
爲大臣者係天下安危之重或假節以
督兵淮蔡卒底於平或納陛以召對社
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十三
punctuated:
吕新書以傳於世，庶幾古人之成法有可考者。使其見用於時，不知果足以成中和之治否歟？我國家列聖有作，累葉重光，正積德久而禮樂可興之時也。諸士子生際其盛，行當有爲明天子獻者，其將何所挾而往乎？

問：自古任天下之大事，必有老成才識者以當之，而後計可决，功可成，變可濟也。故《易》稱丈人，《書》美黃髮，其訓有不可易者。考之於古，隱居磻溪者成肆伐之功，弼亮四世者受保釐之寄，周人家法具見於是矣。其後，有監于夷門，趙賴以存；少不如人，鄭仰其救；請用兵六十萬，而竟滅乎荆楚；陳留屯十二事，而坐困乎先零；薦以竒才者，收唐室匡復之功；呼爲大臣者，係天下安危之重。或假節以督兵，淮蔡卒底於平；或納陛以召對，社
translation_en:
…the New Treatise on the Pitch Pipes (Lülü xinshu), transmitting it to the world, in the hope that the established methods of the ancients might thereby become accessible to investigation. Had these men been employed in their own age, would they truly have been capable of bringing about government characterized by equilibrium and harmony? In our dynasty, sage sovereigns have arisen in succession, their glory renewed from generation to generation. This is precisely a time when virtue has long been accumulated and rites and music can flourish. You candidates have been born into this flourishing age and will soon have something to present to our enlightened Son of Heaven. What, then, will you bring before him?

Question: From antiquity, responsibility for the great affairs of the realm has necessarily been entrusted to seasoned men of ability and discernment. Only then can plans be settled, achievements accomplished, and crises overcome. Thus the Book of Changes commends the mature man, and the Book of Documents praises those with yellowed hair. These teachings contain principles that cannot be altered. Examining antiquity, we find that the recluse of Panxi accomplished the great punitive campaign, while the man who assisted and enlightened four generations of rulers was entrusted with protecting and governing the realm. The governing traditions of the Zhou house are fully manifest in these examples.

Thereafter, there was a man who kept watch at Yimen [?], on whom Zhao depended for its survival; another, who in youth had been inferior to others, was looked to by Zheng for deliverance. One requested an army of six hundred thousand and ultimately destroyed Jing-Chu; another set forth twelve arguments for keeping troops stationed in place and wore down the Xianling without advancing. One recommended for his extraordinary ability accomplished the restoration of the Tang ruling house; another, acclaimed as a great minister, bore responsibility for the security or peril of the realm. One was granted a staff of authority to command the troops, and Huai and Cai were finally pacified; another was summoned for an imperial audience with steps provided for his ascent, and the altars of the soil …

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
稷于焉攸賴手疏上納以老臣而屬天
子動念之勤宿德立朝以異人而起遼
使竦然之敬或調和兩宮左右畏之而
不敢動或歷相三朝天下賴之而以為
安此皆老成成功者之明效也然其間
或取辦於一時亦或得之於素養或有
假於知謀亦或不俟夫聲色果以何者
為優乎夫論其人不知其世不可也諸
生其一評之將採以為
===
今日圖舊之一助焉
問古之君子志于天下要皆有素業焉若
伊尹堯舜君民之具寔定於畝畝中而
孔明之在草廬未求聞達知者已稱其
為識時務之俊傑其規恢之計亦講之
熟矣諸子抱藝而來豈無志古人之志
者乎茲不暇遠舉姑以閩中急務之一
二相與籌之人才所以覘教化也延邵
諸郡昔為多賢講道之地今何絃歌俎
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十四
punctuated:
稷于焉攸賴。手疏上納，以老臣而屬天子動念之勤；宿德立朝，以異人而起遼使竦然之敬。或調和兩宮，左右畏之而不敢動；或歷相三朝，天下賴之而以為安。此皆老成成功者之明效也。然其間，或取辦於一時，亦或得之於素養；或有假於知謀，亦或不俟夫聲色。果以何者為優乎？夫論其人，不知其世，不可也。諸生其一評之，將採以為今日圖舊之一助焉。
問：古之君子志于天下，要皆有素業焉。若伊尹堯舜君民之具，寔定於畝畝中；而孔明之在草廬，未求聞達，知者已稱其為識時務之俊傑，其規恢之計亦講之熟矣。諸子抱藝而來，豈無志古人之志者乎？茲不暇遠舉，姑以閩中急務之一二，相與籌之。人才所以覘教化也。延邵諸郡，昔為多賢講道之地，今何絃歌俎
translation_en:
…the state thereby found support. One submitted a memorial in his own hand and, as a veteran minister, commanded the Emperor’s solicitous remembrance; another stood at court with long-established virtue and inspired awed respect in the Liao envoy as an extraordinary man. Some reconciled the two palaces, so that their attendants feared them and dared not act; others served as chief councillors through three reigns, and all under Heaven relied upon them for security. These are all clear demonstrations of the achievements of seasoned men. Yet among them, some met the needs of a particular moment, while others owed their success to longstanding cultivation; some relied on wisdom and strategy, while others had no need even to raise their voices or assume a stern expression. Which, then, deserves preference? To judge a man without knowing his age is impossible. You candidates should assess them all; your judgments will be drawn upon to assist today’s efforts to seek out veteran servants.
Question: The gentlemen of antiquity set their aspirations upon all under Heaven, and all, in essence, had prepared themselves beforehand. Yi Yin’s means of making his ruler a Yao or Shun and his people the people of Yao and Shun were already firmly established while he was among the fields [?]. When Kongming was still in his thatched cottage, before seeking recognition or advancement, those who knew him already acclaimed him as an outstanding man who understood the needs of the times; he had also thoroughly considered his plans for expansion and restoration. You have come bearing your scholarly accomplishments: surely some among you aspire to the aspirations of the ancients? There is no time here to range over distant examples. Let us instead deliberate together upon one or two urgent matters in Fujian. Men of talent provide a means of gauging moral instruction. The prefectures of Yanping, Shaowu, and their neighbors were once places where many worthy men expounded the Way. Why is it now that the tradition of singing to stringed accompaniment and setting out sacrificial vessels…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
豆之風微而科目之選或間歲一舉乎
獄訟所以觀風俗也泉漳二郡舊亦大
儒過化之所今何鼠牙雀角之風盛而
蝟興之獄或經年不决乎鹽課有定法
也何疏通之難而致廑大臣之遣貢賦
有常供也何逋負者眾而屢煩部使之
行兵本凶器不可以屢試者往年汀州
之寇甫除而今又見告於漳矣干戈何
時而已乎歲之大侵不可以屢見者往
===
年興泉之饑已甚而今又幷及於漳矣
民生何日而瘳乎夫事之弊也必有轉
移之機而變之來也必有拯捄之術凡
是數者皆諸生之目擊而心疚焉者其
將何施而可
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十五
punctuated: 豆之風微，而科目之選或間歲一舉乎？獄訟所以觀風俗也，泉漳二郡舊亦大儒過化之所，今何鼠牙雀角之風盛，而蝟興之獄或經年不决乎？鹽課有定法也，何疏通之難，而致廑大臣之遣？貢賦有常供也，何逋負者眾，而屢煩部使之行？兵本凶器，不可以屢試者，往年汀州之寇甫除，而今又見告於漳矣，干戈何時而已乎？歲之大侵，不可以屢見者，往年興泉之饑已甚，而今又幷及於漳矣，民生何日而瘳乎？夫事之弊也，必有轉移之機；而變之來也，必有拯捄之術。凡是數者，皆諸生之目擊而心疚焉者，其將何施而可？
translation_en:
…the ethos of ritual and music has declined, and selection through the examinations sometimes yields only one successful candidate every other year? Litigation offers a means of observing local customs. The two prefectures of Quanzhou and Zhangzhou were formerly places transformed by the presence of great Confucian scholars. Why, then, does contentious wrangling now flourish, while lawsuits spring up like a hedgehog’s bristles, some remaining unresolved for years? There are established regulations for the salt revenue. Why has making its administration run smoothly proved so difficult that it has occasioned the dispatch of a high minister? Tribute and taxes have regular quotas. Why are so many in arrears that ministry envoys must repeatedly be troubled to travel here? Arms are inherently instruments of ill omen and should not repeatedly be put to use. The bandits of Tingzhou had only just been eliminated in recent years, yet now reports of banditry come again from Zhangzhou. When will warfare cease? Great crop failures should not recur so frequently. The famine in Xinghua and Quanzhou was already severe in recent years, yet now it has spread to Zhangzhou as well. When will the people’s livelihoods recover?

When affairs deteriorate, there must be an opportunity to turn them around; when calamity comes, there must be a means of relief. These several matters are all things that you students have witnessed with your own eyes and that have distressed your hearts. What measures, then, would be appropriate?

punctuated:

第二十七名吳希澄 晉江縣學生 易
