title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
瞻之在前忽焉在後
夫微之顯誠之不可揜如此夫
日月有明容光必照焉
易
剛自外來而為主於內
健而說决而和
故神无方而易无體
===
是故變化云為吉事有祥象事知器占事
知來天地設位聖人成能人謀鬼謀百
姓與能
書
一日二日萬幾
監于先王成憲其永無愆惟說式克欽承
旁招俊乂列于庶位王曰嗚呼說四海
之內咸仰朕德時乃風股肱惟人良臣
惟聖昔先正保衡作我先王乃曰予弗
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 五
punctuated:
第壹場

四書

瞻之在前，忽焉在後。

夫微之顯，誠之不可揜，如此夫！

日月有明，容光必照焉。

易

剛自外來而為主於內。

健而說，决而和。

故神无方而易无體。

是故變化云為，吉事有祥；象事知器，占事知來。天地設位，聖人成能；人謀鬼謀，百姓與能。

書

一日二日，萬幾。

監于先王成憲，其永無愆。惟說式克欽承。

旁招俊乂，列于庶位。王曰：「嗚呼！說，四海之內，咸仰朕德，時乃風。股肱惟人，良臣惟聖。昔先正保衡，作我先王，乃曰：『予弗
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

“I look toward it ahead; suddenly it is behind.”

“How the subtle becomes manifest, and how sincerity cannot be concealed—such is their nature!”

“The sun and moon possess brightness; wherever light can enter, they are sure to shine.”

Book of Changes

“The firm comes from outside and becomes the master within.”

“Strong yet joyful; decisive yet harmonious.”

“Thus the spiritual has no fixed location, and change has no fixed form.”

“Thus, in transformations and in speech and action, auspicious undertakings have favorable signs. By modeling things, one comes to understand implements; by divining about affairs, one comes to know what is to come. Heaven and earth establish their positions, and the sage brings their capacities to fulfillment. People deliberate, and spirits deliberate; the common people participate in this capacity.”

Book of Documents

“In a single day or two days, there are myriad incipient affairs to attend to.”

“Look to the established statutes of the former kings, and you will forever be free of error.” Yue respectfully undertook to receive and carry this out.

“He sought widely for men of outstanding talent and ability and placed them in the various offices. The king said: ‘Ah, Yue! All within the four seas look up to my virtue; this is the result of your instruction. As arms and legs make a man complete, so worthy ministers make a sage ruler. Formerly, the former minister, the Guardian and Counselor, assisted our former king and said: “I do not …”’

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
克俾厥后惟堯舜其心愧耻若撻于市
一夫不獲則曰時予之辜佑我烈祖格
于皇天爾尚明保予罔俾阿衡專美有
商惟后非賢不乂惟賢非后不食其爾
克紹乃辟于先王永綏民說拜稽首曰
敢對揚天子之休命
視曰明聽曰聰
惟齊非齊有倫有要
詩
===
我送舅氏曰至渭陽何以贈之路車乘黄
我送舅氏悠悠我思何以贈之瓊瑰玉
佩
衆維魚矣旐維旟矣
作之屏之其菑其翳脩之平之其灌其栵
啓之辟之其檉其椐攘之剔之其檿其
柘
受小國是達受大國是達
banxin: 福建鄉試録 六
punctuated:
克俾厥后惟堯舜，其心愧耻若撻于市。一夫不獲，則曰：「時予之辜。」佑我烈祖，格于皇天。爾尚明保予，罔俾阿衡專美有商。惟后非賢不乂，惟賢非后不食。其爾克紹乃辟于先王，永綏民。」說拜稽首曰：「敢對揚天子之休命。」
視曰明，聽曰聰。
惟齊非齊，有倫有要。
詩
我送舅氏，曰至渭陽。何以贈之？路車乘黄。我送舅氏，悠悠我思。何以贈之？瓊瑰玉佩。
衆維魚矣，旐維旟矣。
作之屏之，其菑其翳；脩之平之，其灌其栵；啓之辟之，其檉其椐；攘之剔之，其檿其柘。
受小國是達，受大國是達。
translation_en:
… make his sovereign the equal of Yao and Shun, he felt as ashamed as if he had been flogged in the marketplace. If even one person failed to obtain his due, he would say, “This is my fault.” He assisted our illustrious ancestor, whose virtue reached august Heaven. May you wisely protect me, and not let Aheng alone enjoy the distinction of serving the Shang. Without worthy ministers, a sovereign cannot govern; without a sovereign, worthy ministers cannot receive their sustenance. May you enable your ruler to carry on the work of the former kings and bring lasting peace to the people.” Yue bowed and knocked his head to the ground, saying, “I venture to acknowledge and extol the Son of Heaven’s gracious command.”
Seeing should be clear; hearing should be acute.
Bring order to what is disorderly, observing its proper relationships and essential principles.
Book of Odes
I escorted my maternal uncle as far as the northern bank of the Wei. What should I give him? A grand carriage and a team of four yellow horses. I escorted my maternal uncle; my thoughts lingered long. What should I give him? Precious stones and jade pendants.
The people were as numerous as fish; the tortoise-and-snake banners and the falcon banners flew.
They cut down and cleared away the dead trees and the shading growth. They trimmed and levelled the shrubs and the trees sprouting from stumps. They opened and cleared the ground of tamarisks and ju trees. They removed and uprooted the mountain mulberries and the silkworm thorns.
When he received a small state, he brought it to prosperity; when he received a large state, he brought it to prosperity.

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
公會齊人宋人救鄭莊公二十八年
虞師晉師滅下陽僖公二年晉人執虞公
僖公五年楚師滅陳昭公八年楚師滅
蔡昭公十一年晉伐鮮虞昭公十二年
晉侯齊師宋師秦師及楚人戰于城濮楚
師敗績僖公二十八年會于蕭魚襄公
十一年
楚子滅胡以胡子豹歸定公十五年
禮記
===
君車將駕則僕執策立於馬前已駕僕展
輢效駕奮衣由右上取貳綏跪乘執策
分轡驅之五步而立君出就車則僕并
轡授綏左右攘辟車驅而騶至于大門
君撫僕之手而顧命車右就車門閭溝
渠必步
大樂必易大禮必簡
君子也者人之成名也
廉而不劌義也
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 七
punctuated:
公會齊人、宋人救鄭，莊公二十八年。
虞師、晉師滅下陽，僖公二年。晉人執虞公，僖公五年。楚師滅陳，昭公八年。楚師滅蔡，昭公十一年。晉伐鮮虞，昭公十二年。
晉侯、齊師、宋師、秦師及楚人戰于城濮，楚師敗績，僖公二十八年。會于蕭魚，襄公十一年。
楚子滅胡，以胡子豹歸，定公十五年。
禮記
君車將駕，則僕執策立於馬前。已駕，僕展輢、效駕，奮衣，由右上，取貳綏，跪乘，執策，分轡，驅之五步而立。君出就車，則僕并轡授綏，左右攘辟。車驅而騶，至于大門，君撫僕之手而顧，命車右就車。門閭溝渠必步。
大樂必易，大禮必簡。
君子也者，人之成名也。
廉而不劌，義也。
translation_en:
The duke joined men of Qi and Song in relieving Zheng. Twenty-eighth year of Duke Zhuang.

The armies of Yu and Jin destroyed Xiayang. Second year of Duke Xi. The men of Jin seized the Duke of Yu. Fifth year of Duke Xi. The army of Chu destroyed Chen. Eighth year of Duke Zhao. The army of Chu destroyed Cai. Eleventh year of Duke Zhao. Jin attacked Xianyu. Twelfth year of Duke Zhao.

The Marquis of Jin and the armies of Qi, Song, and Qin fought the men of Chu at Chengpu. The army of Chu suffered a crushing defeat. Twenty-eighth year of Duke Xi. They met at Xiaoyu. Eleventh year of Duke Xiang.

The Viscount of Chu destroyed Hu and returned with Bao, Viscount of Hu. Fifteenth year of Duke Ding.

Book of Rites (Liji)

When the horses are about to be harnessed to the ruler’s carriage, the driver stands before them holding his whip. Once they are harnessed, he inspects the carriage’s side supports and checks the harnessing. Lifting his robes, he mounts from the right, takes the secondary mounting cord, kneels in the carriage, holds his whip, separates the reins, and drives forward five paces before stopping. When the ruler comes out to mount the carriage, the driver gathers the reins and offers him the mounting cord; the attendants on either side withdraw to clear the way. The carriage moves forward, and the horses break into a trot. On reaching the main gate, the ruler lays his hand on the driver’s hand, turns to look back, and orders the attendant on the right to mount. At gateways, village gates, ditches, and channels, the horses must proceed at a walk.

Great music must be easy; great ritual must be simple.

“Gentleman” is the designation of a person who has attained completeness.

To have sharp edges without cutting others is righteousness.

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
第貳場
論
堯舜通天下為一身
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
擬漢戒二千石脩職事詔〔景帝後二年〕
擬唐以褚遂良為黃門侍郎參預朝政誥
〔貞觀十八年〕
擬宋詔日開經筵呂公著司馬光謝表〔治〕
〔平元年〕
===
判語〔五條〕
同寮代判署文案
蒙古色目人婚姻
見任官輒自立碑
從征守禦官軍逃
放火故燒人房屋
第參場
策〔五道〕
問自古帝王之創業必建立規制以貽子
banxin: 福建鄉試錄八
punctuated:
第貳場

論：堯舜通天下為一身。

詔誥表〔內科一道〕：擬漢戒二千石脩職事詔〔景帝後二年〕；擬唐以褚遂良為黃門侍郎參預朝政誥〔貞觀十八年〕；擬宋詔日開經筵呂公著司馬光謝表〔治〕〔平元年〕。

判語〔五條〕：同寮代判署文案；蒙古色目人婚姻；見任官輒自立碑；從征守禦官軍逃；放火故燒人房屋。

第參場

策〔五道〕：問：自古帝王之創業，必建立規制，以貽子
translation_en:
Second Session

Discourse: Yao and Shun regarded all under Heaven as a single body.

Edicts, proclamations, and memorials [one topic from among these [?]]:
Compose an edict in the manner of the Han dynasty admonishing officials of the two-thousand-bushel rank to attend diligently to their official duties [second year of Emperor Jing’s Later Era].
Compose a proclamation in the manner of the Tang dynasty appointing Chu Suiliang as Vice Director of the Chancellery, participating in the deliberation of court affairs [eighteenth year of Zhenguan].
Compose a memorial of thanks in the manner of Lü Gongzhu and Sima Guang of the Song dynasty upon an imperial edict ordering daily Classics Colloquia [first year of Zhiping].

Legal judgments [five items]:
An official adjudicating and signing documents on behalf of a colleague.
Marriage involving Mongols and Semu people.
An incumbent official erecting a commemorative stele for himself without authorization.
Desertion by officers and soldiers serving on campaigns or garrison duty.
Setting fires deliberately to burn other people’s houses.

Third Session

Policy essays [five questions]:
Question: Since antiquity, emperors and kings, when founding their realms, have invariably established institutions and regulations to bequeath to their children…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
孫唐虞三代典則具存有足徵者自是
而降惟漢之高祖肇造漢家四百年之
鴻業號爲最盛而史臣之賛但云規模
宏遠而不及其詳何也洪惟我
太祖高皇帝以神聖之資際貞元之會不階尺
土奮起淮甸掃除雄奸曾未數載而履
帝位雖當干戈倥偬之餘而常留意於制作宏
綱旣舉萬目又張凡前王之所未行與
行之而未盡者皆燦然有條而可以爲
===
後世法誠所謂度越千古者矣當時儒
臣宋濂之序
聖政記乃特借漢以爲喻始言與高祖同繼言
非高祖之所能及旣而又言比隆於唐
虞三代不知所同者何事所不能及者
何功而所可比隆乎前聖者又何道歟
今觀七類之中固皆有關於政要然天
地之化工誠非摹寫者所能盡然亦有
可類舉者歟諸士子躬逢其盛涵育
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 九
punctuated: 孫。唐虞三代典則具存，有足徵者。自是而降，惟漢之高祖肇造漢家四百年之鴻業，號爲最盛，而史臣之賛但云規模宏遠，而不及其詳，何也？洪惟我太祖高皇帝，以神聖之資，際貞元之會，不階尺土，奮起淮甸，掃除雄奸，曾未數載而履帝位。雖當干戈倥偬之餘，而常留意於制作，宏綱旣舉，萬目又張。凡前王之所未行與行之而未盡者，皆燦然有條，而可以爲後世法，誠所謂度越千古者矣。當時儒臣宋濂之序《聖政記》，乃特借漢以爲喻：始言與高祖同，繼言非高祖之所能及，旣而又言比隆於唐虞三代。不知所同者何事，所不能及者何功，而所可比隆乎前聖者又何道歟？今觀七類之中，固皆有關於政要，然天地之化工，誠非摹寫者所能盡，然亦有可類舉者歟？諸士子躬逢其盛，涵育
translation_en:
…descendants. The established institutions and rules of Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties survive in full, providing evidence that can be consulted. Thereafter, Gaozu of Han alone founded the great enterprise of the Han house, which endured for four hundred years and was acclaimed as supremely flourishing. Yet the historian’s appraisal says only that his framework was vast and far-reaching, without setting out its particulars. Why is this?

We reverently consider how our Emperor Taizu Gao, endowed with sagely and divine qualities, encountered the moment when an old cosmic cycle ended and a new one began. Without so much as a foot of territory on which to build, he rose in the Huai region, swept away powerful villains, and within a few years ascended the imperial throne. Even amid the aftermath of hurried warfare, he constantly attended to establishing institutions. Once the great guiding framework had been raised, its myriad particulars were also put in order. Whatever earlier rulers had left undone, or had undertaken without completing, was clearly and systematically arranged, providing models for later generations. Truly, he may be said to have surpassed all antiquity.

In his preface to the Record of Sagely Government (Shengzheng ji), the Confucian court official Song Lian of that time expressly used the Han as an analogy. He first said that our emperor resembled Gaozu, then that Gaozu could not match him, and subsequently that he equaled Tang, Yu, and the Three Dynasties in greatness. In what affairs did they resemble one another? In what achievements could Gaozu not match him? And through what Way could he equal the sages of former times in greatness?

Looking now at the seven categories, all certainly concern the essentials of government. Yet the transforming work of Heaven and Earth truly cannot be exhausted by anyone’s portrayal. Even so, might examples be cited by category? You examination candidates have personally encountered this flourishing age and have been nurtured…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
聖政之餘澤蓋有年矣是必有習聞而與知者
其敬敷揚之毋畧
問通天下之故而達四方之志非史莫考
也蓋歷代相因之文備得失而垂鑒戒
故讀史者必師其迹若際其時面其人
而與之共事焉則庶乎其能擇矣然而
獨思則滯而不通獨爲則困而不就姑
舉當時之施行與夫先儒之辯論者數
事與諸士商之考室宣王所以中興大
===
營宫室者或指其計在定都何有於不
知所務制作周公所以盛治請興禮樂
者或稱其身任天下何有於專事紛更
考道藝而興賢能取士之制古矣爲吏
部而論罷科舉何惜其志不及施内經
國而外籌邊納榷之源遠矣爲户部而
奏變鹽法何駁其議無可用明君以務
學爲急四學並立胡爲而二道養民以
愛力爲本三長定户奚爲其不可宰相
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十
punctuated:
聖政之餘澤，蓋有年矣。是必有習聞而與知者，其敬敷揚之，毋畧。

問：通天下之故，而達四方之志，非史莫考也。蓋歷代相因之文，備得失而垂鑒戒，故讀史者必師其迹，若際其時、面其人，而與之共事焉，則庶乎其能擇矣。然而獨思則滯而不通，獨爲則困而不就。姑舉當時之施行與夫先儒之辯論者數事，與諸士商之。考室，宣王所以中興；大營宫室者，或指其計在定都，何有於不知所務？制作，周公所以盛治；請興禮樂者，或稱其身任天下，何有於專事紛更？考道藝而興賢能，取士之制古矣。爲吏部而論罷科舉，何惜其志不及施？内經國而外籌邊，納榷之源遠矣。爲户部而奏變鹽法，何駁其議無可用？明君以務學爲急，四學並立，胡爲而二道？養民以愛力爲本，三長定户，奚爲其不可？宰相
translation_en:
…the beneficence flowing from sage government has nurtured you for many years. Surely there are matters with which you have become familiar through hearing and in which you have gained understanding. Reverently expound and celebrate them, omitting nothing.

Question: To comprehend the affairs of the world and understand the aspirations of the four quarters, there is nothing to consult but history. The writings handed down through successive dynasties fully record successes and failures and transmit lessons and warnings. Thus readers of history must take past deeds as their teachers, as though they lived in those times, met those people face to face, and worked alongside them. Only then may they approach the ability to choose wisely. Yet thinking alone leads to obstruction without understanding, and acting alone leads to difficulty without accomplishment. Let us therefore select several instances of measures implemented in their day and arguments advanced by earlier Confucian scholars, and discuss them with you gentlemen.

The completion of a palace was a means by which King Xuan achieved restoration. Of one who undertook extensive palace construction, some have argued that his purpose was to establish the capital. How, then, could he be accused of failing to understand his proper priorities? The establishment of institutions was a means by which the Duke of Zhou achieved flourishing government. Of one who requested the institution of rites and music, some have said that he personally shouldered responsibility for the realm. How, then, could he be accused of devoting himself solely to disruptive changes?

Examining moral cultivation and accomplishments, and promoting the worthy and capable: the system for selecting officials is ancient. Why, when a man serving in the Ministry of Personnel argued for abolishing the civil-service examinations, was it regretted that his purpose could not be put into practice? Ordering the state internally and making provision for the frontiers externally: the origins of fiscal receipts and monopolies [?] reach far back. Why, when a man serving in the Ministry of Revenue memorialized to change the salt regulations, was his proposal rejected as wholly impracticable?

An enlightened ruler regards dedication to learning as urgent. When four schools were established together, why were there two Ways [?]? Nurturing the people rests on conserving their labor. Why was the determination of household registration through the Three Chiefs system deemed unacceptable? The chief councilor…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
百官之表智慮過人者何忽經濟之儒
諫議儆君之闕才稱傑出者何舍剛正
之士棄凉州倂力而守邊郡補衣之喻
似矣疽食何以見憂出駱谷乘虛而向
秦川善攻之計得矣仇國何爲有諷更
化則善治也或每陳利害而一切報罷
或因求改制而勸行清淨厥義何居故
事可覆撿也或擇用衙官而斥去例簿
或始視銓事而命具科條所見孰得蓋
===
泥細故者必畧大猷要近效者必忘遠
利况夫形迹相持公私相撓事變之來
豈必盡強人意哉諸士子皆明當世之
務習先聖之術其有見乎此也審矣然
事貴有驗而言棄無徴盍爲我悉心焉
問樂之難知也久矣考之樂記有知聲知
音知樂之等而釋之者謂孔子在齊之
所聞季札聘魯之所觀乃君子之知樂
者夫聞韶之旨固不可得而考矣而札
banxin: 福建鄕試錄 十一
punctuated:
百官之表，智慮過人者，何忽經濟之儒？諫議儆君之闕，才稱傑出者，何舍剛正之士？棄凉州，倂力而守邊郡，補衣之喻似矣，疽食何以見憂？出駱谷，乘虛而向秦川，善攻之計得矣，仇國何爲有諷？更化則善治也，或每陳利害而一切報罷，或因求改制而勸行清淨，厥義何居？故事可覆撿也，或擇用衙官而斥去例簿，或始視銓事而命具科條，所見孰得？蓋泥細故者必畧大猷，要近效者必忘遠利。况夫形迹相持，公私相撓，事變之來，豈必盡強人意哉？諸士子皆明當世之務，習先聖之術，其有見乎此也審矣。然事貴有驗，而言棄無徴，盍爲我悉心焉？
問：樂之難知也久矣。考之《樂記》，有知聲、知音、知樂之等，而釋之者謂孔子在齊之所聞、季札聘魯之所觀，乃君子之知樂者。夫聞韶之旨，固不可得而考矣，而札
translation_en:
…the exemplar for all officials: why did one whose intelligence and judgment surpassed others neglect scholars versed in ordering the state and bringing relief to the people? The Remonstrance Official warns the ruler of his failings: why did one acclaimed for exceptional talent pass over men of integrity and rectitude? Abandoning Liangzhou and concentrating forces to defend the frontier commanderies—the analogy of patching a garment seems apt; why, then, was concern expressed about a devouring ulcer? Emerging through Luogu and exploiting an opening to advance toward Qinchuan—the plan seems to have grasped the art of attack; why, then, was there an admonition concerning an enemy state [?]? Reform should bring good government. Yet in one case, proposals setting forth advantages and disadvantages were invariably rejected; in another, a request to change institutions prompted advice to govern through quietude and noninterference. What principles underlay these decisions? Established precedents can be examined: one man selected subordinate officials for employment and discarded the register of precedents, while another, upon first taking charge of official selection, ordered that the relevant regulations be set out in full. Whose view was sound? Those who cling to minor details inevitably neglect great plans, and those who seek immediate results inevitably forget long-term benefits. Moreover, when outward conduct becomes grounds for mutual opposition [?], and public and private interests interfere with each other, how could unfolding events always accord fully with one’s wishes? You candidates all understand the affairs of the present age and have studied the methods of the ancient sages; surely you have considered these matters carefully. Yet affairs require verification, and unsupported statements are to be rejected. Will you not give these questions your fullest attention for me?
Question: Music has long been difficult to understand. Examining the Record of Music, we find distinctions between understanding sounds, understanding musical tones, and understanding music. Its interpreters say that what Confucius heard in Qi and what Ji Zha observed on his diplomatic visit to Lu exemplify the gentleman’s understanding of music. The deeper meaning of hearing the Shao music can, indeed, no longer be ascertained; but as for Zha…

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
之所觀諸樂皆能知其德而通其政而
或者又議其論小雅豳風之失是果然
歟自是以降知樂者益鮮然亦有得趙
之牛鐸與周之玉尺者皆擅暗解神解
之名有依準以調八音與扣器以成宮
商者皆得心達心領之妙或得潤州之
玉磬而知夫黃鍾之缺或見岑陽之古
鍾而識爲姑洗之角或仰觀雲物而知
律管之飛灰或俯按樂圖而辯霓裳之
===
三疊之數子者其於季札果若是其班
歟夫審聲知音固幾於樂矣他如司馬
遷之律書不言律而言兵不言兵之用
而言兵之偃何以謂其知制律之意諸
葛亮之治蜀干戈方動于一隅而設施
未及於天下何以謂其禮樂之可興果
亦有其說歟近世以來又有朱蔡二先
生者出慨然以斯道自任乃獨究心於
殘篇斷簡之中而集爲通解鍾律與律
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十二
punctuated: 之所觀諸樂，皆能知其德而通其政，而或者又議其論小雅、豳風之失，是果然歟？自是以降，知樂者益鮮，然亦有得趙之牛鐸與周之玉尺者，皆擅暗解、神解之名；有依準以調八音與扣器以成宮商者，皆得心達、心領之妙。或得潤州之玉磬而知夫黃鍾之缺，或見岑陽之古鍾而識爲姑洗之角，或仰觀雲物而知律管之飛灰，或俯按樂圖而辯霓裳之三疊。之數子者，其於季札，果若是其班歟？夫審聲知音，固幾於樂矣。他如司馬遷之律書，不言律而言兵，不言兵之用而言兵之偃，何以謂其知制律之意？諸葛亮之治蜀，干戈方動于一隅，而設施未及於天下，何以謂其禮樂之可興？果亦有其說歟？近世以來，又有朱蔡二先生者出，慨然以斯道自任，乃獨究心於殘篇斷簡之中，而集爲通解鍾律與律
translation_en:
…of the various musical performances he witnessed, he could discern the virtue expressed in each and comprehend its government. Yet some have criticized his judgments of the Lesser Odes and the Airs of Bin as mistaken. Is this really so? Since then, those who understand music have become increasingly rare. Nevertheless, there were those who obtained a cattle bell from Zhao or a jade ruler from Zhou, winning reputations for intuitive or inspired understanding. Others used a pitch-standard instrument to tune the eight classes of musical instruments, or struck vessels to produce the gong and shang notes, attaining the subtle mastery of inward comprehension and intuitive grasp. One obtained a jade chime stone from Runzhou and recognized a deficiency in the Huangzhong pitch; another saw an ancient bell from Cenyang and identified it as the jue note of the Guxian pitch. One looked up at the configurations of clouds and understood the flying ash in the pitch pipes; another bent over musical charts and distinguished the three sections of the Rainbow Skirts melody. Were these men really of the same rank as Ji Zha in their understanding?

Careful discrimination of sounds and understanding of tones certainly approach an understanding of music. But consider other cases. In Sima Qian’s Treatise on the Pitch Standards, he discusses warfare rather than pitch standards, and the cessation of warfare rather than its conduct. Why is he said to have understood the intent behind establishing pitch standards? When Zhuge Liang governed Shu, warfare was underway in just one corner of the realm, and his measures had not extended throughout the world. Why is it said that he could have brought rites and music to flourishing? Is there indeed an explanation for these claims?

In more recent times, the two masters Zhu and Cai emerged and resolutely took responsibility for this Way. They devoted their attention specifically to fragmentary writings and broken bamboo slips, compiling the bell-and-pitch material of the Comprehensive Explanations [?] and the Pitch …

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
呂新書以傳於世庶幾古人之成法有
可考者使其見用於時不知果足以成
中和之治否歟我
國家
列聖有作累葉重光正積德久而禮樂可興之
時也諸士子生際其盛行當有為
明天子獻者其將何所挾而往乎
問自古任天下之大事必有老成才識者
以當之而後計可決功可成變可濟也
===
故易稱丈人書美黃髮其訓有不可易
者考之於古隱居磻溪者成肆伐之功
弼亮四世者受保釐之寄周人家法具
見於是矣其後有監于夷門趙賴以存
少不如人鄭仰其救請用兵六十萬而
竟滅乎荆楚陳留屯十二事而坐困乎
先零薦以奇才者收唐室匡復之功呼
為大臣者係天下安危之重或假節以
督兵淮蔡卒底於平或納陛以召對社
banxin: 福建鄉試錄十三
punctuated:
呂新書，以傳於世，庶幾古人之成法有可考者。使其見用於時，不知果足以成中和之治否歟？我國家列聖有作，累葉重光，正積德久而禮樂可興之時也。諸士子生際其盛，行當有為明天子獻者，其將何所挾而往乎？
問：自古任天下之大事，必有老成才識者以當之，而後計可決，功可成，變可濟也。故易稱丈人，書美黃髮，其訓有不可易者。考之於古，隱居磻溪者成肆伐之功，弼亮四世者受保釐之寄，周人家法具見於是矣。其後，有監于夷門，趙賴以存；少不如人，鄭仰其救；請用兵六十萬，而竟滅乎荆楚；陳留屯十二事，而坐困乎先零；薦以奇才者，收唐室匡復之功；呼為大臣者，係天下安危之重；或假節以督兵，淮蔡卒底於平；或納陛以召對，社
translation_en:
…New Book on Pitch Pipes, to transmit it to the world, in the hope that the established methods of the ancients might still be examined. Had these men been employed in their own time, would they truly have been capable of bringing about government characterized by equilibrium and harmony? In our dynasty, successive sage sovereigns have arisen, their glory renewed from generation to generation. This is precisely a time when virtue has long accumulated and rites and music may flourish. You candidates have been born amid this prosperity and will soon have something to offer our enlightened Son of Heaven. What will you take with you when you go before him?
Question: From antiquity, responsibility for the great affairs of the realm has required mature and experienced men of ability and discernment. Only then can plans be settled, achievements accomplished, and crises overcome. Thus the Book of Changes commends the elder, and the Book of Documents praises those with yellowed hair. These teachings contain principles that cannot be altered. Looking back to antiquity, the man who lived in retirement at Panxi achieved success in the punitive campaign; the man who assisted and guided four generations received the charge of protecting and governing. The inherited principles of the Zhou house are fully evident in these cases.
Thereafter, there was one who served as a watchman at Yimen [?], on whom Zhao depended for its survival; one who in youth had been inferior to others, to whom Zheng looked for deliverance; one who requested an army of six hundred thousand and ultimately destroyed Jing-Chu; and one who presented twelve arguments for keeping troops stationed in agricultural colonies and thereby wore down the Xianling without fighting. One recommended for his exceptional talents achieved the restoration of the Tang ruling house; one acclaimed as a great minister bore responsibility for the security or peril of the realm. One was granted a tally of authority to supervise the armies, and Huai and Cai were finally pacified; another was summoned to an imperial audience with special arrangements at the palace steps [?], and the altars of …

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
稷于焉攸賴手疏上納以老臣而屬天
子動念之勤宿德立朝以異人而起遼
使竦然之敬或調和兩宮左右畏之而
不敢動或歷相三朝天下賴之而以為
安此皆老成成功者之明效也然其間
或取辦於一時亦或得之於素養或有
假於知謀亦或不俟夫聲色果以何者
為優乎夫論其人不知其世不可也諸
生其一評之將採以為
===
今日圖舊之一助焉
問古之君子志于天下要皆有素業焉若
伊尹堯舜君民之具寔定於畝畝中而
孔明之在草廬未求聞達知者已稱其
為識時務之俊傑其規恢之計亦講之
熟矣諸子抱藝而來豈無志古人之志
者乎茲不暇遠舉姑以閩中急務之一
二相與籌之人才所以覘教化也延邵
諸郡昔為多賢講道之邦今何寥寥且
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十四
punctuated:
稷于焉攸賴。手疏上納，以老臣而屬天子動念之勤；宿德立朝，以異人而起遼使竦然之敬。或調和兩宮，左右畏之而不敢動；或歷相三朝，天下賴之而以為安。此皆老成成功者之明效也。然其間，或取辦於一時，亦或得之於素養；或有假於知謀，亦或不俟夫聲色。果以何者為優乎？夫論其人，不知其世，不可也。諸生其一評之，將採以為今日圖舊之一助焉。
問：古之君子，志于天下，要皆有素業焉。若伊尹堯舜君民之具，寔定於畝畝中；而孔明之在草廬，未求聞達，知者已稱其為識時務之俊傑，其規恢之計亦講之熟矣。諸子抱藝而來，豈無志古人之志者乎？茲不暇遠舉，姑以閩中急務之一二，相與籌之。人才所以覘教化也。延邵諸郡，昔為多賢講道之邦，今何寥寥且
translation_en:
…the altars of soil and grain thus depended upon him. One submitted a memorial in his own hand and, as a veteran minister, commanded the Emperor’s solicitous attention; another, a man of long-established virtue serving at court, inspired awed respect in an envoy from Liao, who regarded him as an extraordinary man. Some reconciled the two palaces, so that their attendants feared them and dared not act; others served as chief councilors through three reigns, and all under Heaven relied upon them for security. These are all clear demonstrations of the achievements of seasoned men. Yet among them, some accomplished their tasks through measures suited to the moment, while others succeeded through long cultivation; some relied upon wisdom and strategy, while others had no need even to raise their voices or change their expressions. Which, then, should be judged superior? To assess a man without understanding his age is impossible. You candidates should offer an appraisal of them; we shall draw upon it to assist today’s efforts to seek out experienced servants.
Question: The gentlemen of antiquity set their aspirations upon all under Heaven, and in every case had prepared themselves beforehand. Yi Yin’s means of making his ruler a Yao or Shun and his people the people of Yao and Shun were already firmly established while he was among the fields [?]. When Kongming lived in his thatched cottage, he had not sought fame or advancement, yet those who knew him already praised him as an outstanding man who understood the needs of the times. His plans for expansion and restoration had likewise been thoroughly considered. You gentlemen have come bearing your learning: are there not among you those who share the aspirations of the ancients? We have no leisure here to range far afield in our examples. Let us instead deliberate together upon one or two urgent matters in Fujian. The quality of men of talent is a means of gauging moral instruction. The prefectures of Yanping and Shaowu were formerly places where many worthy men expounded the Way. Why are such men now so few, and moreover …

title: 正德十一年福建鄉試錄
text:
豆之風微而科目之選或間歲一舉乎
獄訟所以觀風俗也泉漳二郡舊亦大
儒過化之所今何鼠牙雀角之風盛而
蝟興之獄或經年不决乎鹽課有定法
也何疏通之難而致廑大臣之遣貢賦
有常供也何逋負者衆而屢煩部使之
行兵本凶器不可以屢試者往年汀州
之寇甫除而今又見告於漳矣干戈何
時而巳乎歲之大侵不可以屢見者往
===
年興泉之饑巳甚而今又幷及於漳矣
民生何日而瘳乎夫事之弊也必有轉
移之機而變之來也必有拯救之術凡
是數者皆諸生之目擊而心疚焉者其
將何施而可
banxin: 福建鄉試錄 十五
punctuated: 豆之風微，而科目之選或間歲一舉乎？獄訟所以觀風俗也，泉漳二郡舊亦大儒過化之所，今何鼠牙雀角之風盛，而蝟興之獄或經年不决乎？鹽課有定法也，何疏通之難，而致廑大臣之遣？貢賦有常供也，何逋負者衆，而屢煩部使之行？兵本凶器，不可以屢試者，往年汀州之寇甫除，而今又見告於漳矣，干戈何時而巳乎？歲之大侵，不可以屢見者，往年興泉之饑巳甚，而今又幷及於漳矣，民生何日而瘳乎？夫事之弊也，必有轉移之機；而變之來也，必有拯救之術。凡是數者，皆諸生之目擊而心疚焉者，其將何施而可？
translation_en:
…the practice of ritual observance [?] has declined, and selection through the examinations may yield a successful candidate only every other year? Litigation is a means of observing social customs. The two prefectures of Quanzhou and Zhangzhou were formerly places transformed by the presence of great Confucian scholars. Why, then, does a contentious spirit—like the proverbial rats’ teeth and sparrows’ horns—now flourish, while lawsuits spring up like hedgehog bristles, some remaining unresolved for an entire year?

Salt revenues are governed by established regulations. Why is it so difficult to make their administration run smoothly that concern has prompted the dispatch of high ministers? Tribute and taxes have regular quotas. Why are so many in arrears that emissaries from the ministries must repeatedly be troubled to travel here?

Weapons are inherently instruments of ill omen and should not repeatedly be put to use. In recent years, the bandits of Tingzhou had barely been eliminated when further reports of banditry arrived from Zhangzhou. When will warfare cease? Great famines should not recur repeatedly. In recent years, famine in Xinghua and Quanzhou was already severe, and now it has extended to Zhangzhou as well. When will the people’s livelihood recover?

When affairs deteriorate, there must be an opportunity to turn them around; when calamity arrives, there must be a means of rescue. All these matters are things that you students have witnessed with your own eyes and grieved over in your hearts. What measures, then, would be appropriate to undertake?
